positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead developer of a patent-pending internal data discovery tool, serving 150-200 monthly active users, replacing documentation and tribal knowledge with an interactive dependency graph in React for discovering, understanding, and accessing data
• Owned UI/UX decisions for features built on the platform
• Review pull requests on an ongoing basis, providing feedback on design and implementation to keep codebase consistent and maintainable
• Lead release and testing meetings for data discovery tool, walking through upcoming features and fixes prior to each production deployment, and owning the full process
• Trained and fine-tuned a Databricks Genie Room AI model for a curated dataset, deployed to production, and surfaced it in the platform so users can ask natural language questions
• Automated the deployment of AWS Lambda functions by integrating Terraform with Gitlab CI/CD pipelines to streamline releases and reduce manual effort
• Migrated client-side for geospatial mapping application from JavaScript to Angular to standardize with the team’s existing stack, improving collaboration and integration with other applications within the team
• Identified a scaling bottleneck in the geospatial platform’s rendering service under concurrent user load and redesigned the deployment by horizontally scaling GeoServer across dual instances per EC2 host with Nginx load balancing
• Designed and submitted a patent-pending serverless architecture for dynamic query caching, reducing cloud compute costs for larger-scale geospatial data queries

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Introduced enhancements and features for desktop and mobile geospatial mapping application  that serves as a tool for users to visualize T-Mobile coverage, sites, and future site development
• Improved and quicken process of uploading geospatial files to application for users by using an AWS Lambda function and S3 Bucket
• Created mobile web application using Ionic Framework and Express server to provide visibility for end-users to effectively see coverage and sites at their current location while in the field
• Deployed EC2 instance on AWS to host a geospatial data rendering service, GeoServer, using Apache Tomcat
• Implemented CI/CD pipeline for web and mobile application to automate the software delivery process using GitLab and Kubernetes
• Built COVID-19 impact layers (impacted jurisdictions, planned sites, and retail stores) and a jurisdiction summary dashboard, giving users visibility into how the pandemic affected site development
• Manage Quality Assurance (QA) session before any production deployment to extensively test any new features and ensure there are no bugs or errors

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented features for a geospatial mapping application for internal customers to visualize T-Mobile coverage and sites, where users can perform business analytics based on business decisions and transactions for the enterprise.
• Worked on a website in Vue.js for a service-first application, using Jazz, that gives more awareness to T-Mobile employees about cellular sites that go on-air
• Managed data integration from one tool to our internal tool using Alteryx, creating automated workflows to move data and adding new features
• Developed in JavaScript, Node.js, and Express
• Created an Android mobile application in Java that allows users to toggle between map layers, using Mapbox

positions.title: Firehose College Ambassador
positions.description:
• Assisted Firehose to find students who would join their online coding bootcamp.
• Spread the word about Firehose's online coding course through social media and the computer science department at Hofstra University.
• By referring more students, the more benefits the students will earn if they sign up.

positions.title: Online Coding Bootcamp
positions.description:
• Enrolled in an online computer-coding course for 12 weeks, learning Ruby on Rails, GitHub, Heroku, while developing web applications.
• Involved weekly one-on-one sessions with a senior developer to work through complex challenges.
• Developed skills and insights to resolve problems using algorithms

positions.title: Global Information Technology Academy
positions.description:
• Four-year computer science program at high school. Learned something new each year: Visual Basic, HTML and Javascript, Flash and Java.
• Worked on different kinds of projects each week and did a final project at the end of each year.
